text: This report is to obtain approval for the removal of the pedestrian refuge island located mid-block on St. Clair Avenue between North Woodrow Avenue and North Bonnington Boulevard. Traffic studies reveal that the warrant or technical justification for the pedestrian refuge island is no longer met at this location since it fails the current environmental criteria for the number of lanes and road width. The refuge island should be replaced with Traffic Control Signals.

City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of St. Clair Avenue East and North Woodrow Boulevard. 2. City Council authorize the removal of the pedestrian refuge island on St. Clair Avenue East, approximately 44 metres east of North Woodrow Boulevard, in conjunction with the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of St. Clair Avenue East and North Woodrow Boulevard.
